1 published version of [The showroom: what the Sovereign Website hub shows after its first days, 33 live sites from one pipeline, people's portfolios with five designs each, independent brochures for our startups, a provider guide, tools that run on the owner's own key, made-up businesses, a family of news sites, and the theme that is emerging across all of them, a site that is yours, says how it was made and can be worked on by your own AI](../the-showroom.md). The current one is **v1.0.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out. Views extracted from an article, such as the Five readers, are not part of its text and do not change its version.
